correctness.rationale: For n>=3, theta>0, ordinary Ewens fixed-point/descent covariances are covered by earlier result. The new comparison W=1{pi(n)>pi(1)} has marginal w_n=[binom(n,2)+2(n-1)(theta-1)+(theta-1)²]/[(n+theta-1)(n+theta-2)], with doubly fixed arrow correction. Conditioned on a fixed label, its probability is 1 at either endpoint, w_{n-1} otherwise. Thus Cov(F,W)=p_n[2+(n-2)w_{n-1}-nw_n], which added to known ordinary covariance factors as -n theta(n-2)(theta-1)(n+2theta-3)/[(n+theta-3)(n+theta-2)(n+theta-1)²]. All denominator factors positive; sign is sign(1-theta), including theta=1 zero without independence. Independent exact permutation sums n3..6 at theta 1/2,1,2,3 matched.
